proposal.summary: A vulnerability in GitLab projects API allows pagination to be skipped, potentially leading to denial-of-service on certain instances. Affected versions are GitLab >=15.2 <16.1.5, >=16.2 <16.2.5, and >=16.3 <16.3.1.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab: versions starting from 15.2 before 16.1.5; starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped, potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

AV.quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped

A.quote: potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm reproducibility and exploitability in a test instance, identify exact request(s) that skip pagination, and develop/verify a patch or mitigation (rate-limiting/validation) before public disclosure.
